name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_d3_mainline_milestone_20260802_211449_208845
sql:
/* D0 创角 cohort 在第 3 自然日内的主线里程碑达成率。关卡名来自各版本 stage 维表。 */
WITH Cfg AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' tc_start, DATE '2026-08-01' tc_end, DATE '2026-05-08' sg_start),
TB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' g,c.u FROM SC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SC c JOIN SA a ON c.u=a.u),
Cohort AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' g,e."#account_id" aid FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"=CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT m.g,e."#account_id" FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"=CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2),
MaxStage AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' g,e."#account_id" aid,MAX(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT)) max_stage FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN Cohort h ON h.g='繁体CBT' AND h.aid=e."#account_id" LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."#event_name"='stage_fight' AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER)=1001 AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT m.g,e."#account_id",MAX(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT)) FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u JOIN Cohort h ON h.g=m.g AND h.aid=e."#account_id" LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."#event_name"='stage_fight' AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER)=1001 AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2),
Stages AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' g,TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) stage_id,MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") name FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765 GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT),MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18203 GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)',TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT),MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18203 GROUP BY 1,2),
Milestones AS (SELECT g,MIN(stage_id) stage_id,name FROM Stages WHERE stage_id IS NOT NULL AND (name LIKE '%:1-1' OR name LIKE '%:10-1' OR name LIKE '%:20-1' OR name LIKE '%:30-1' OR name LIKE '%:40-1' OR name LIKE '%:50-1') GROUP BY 1,3)
SELECT m.g AS "对比组",m.stage_id AS "关卡ID",COALESCE(m.name,CAST(m.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) AS "关卡名称",COUNT(DISTINCT h.aid) AS "D0创角人数",COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.max_stage>=m.stage_id THEN h.aid END) AS "D3已达成人数",ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.max_stage>=m.stage_id THEN h.aid END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT h.aid),0),2) AS "D3达成率(%)" FROM Milestones m JOIN Cohort h ON h.g=m.g LEFT JOIN MaxStage x ON x.g=h.g AND x.aid=h.aid GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2;
